note: Input-controlled long-variable-name text length is copied into the fixed-size longname buffer.
The code assumes str_len is within the destination capacity, but there is no bound check against longname's 64*4+1 size.

code: retval = readstat_convert(info->longname, sizeof(info->longname), variable.name, sizeof(variable.name), ctx->converter);
note: Later code consumes the potentially overflowed longname buffer as a fixed-size string, so the earlier overwrite can corrupt adjacent memory and trigger a crash.
